observations: Arabidopsis study tested cadmium-induced ethylene, ACC, ACS/ACO transcripts, ethylene-responsive genes, and the acs2-1 acs6-1 double mutant; DOI: 10.1186/s12870-014-0212-6.

entities.name: ACS2-ACS6 Cd ethylene
observations: In Arabidopsis, cadmium increased ACC and ethylene; ACS2/ACS6 transcripts rose strongly. The acs2-1 acs6-1 double mutant showed reduced cadmium-induced ethylene, greater leaf biomass, and delayed ethylene-responsive gene induction, supporting a joint contribution but not proving either gene individually necessary.
